Mira: quick heads-up — onboarding sapphire-7b int4 smoke: tokenizer mismatch + small rotary-scale delta. repro below.
Devon: paste minimal repro + tokenizer dump pls.
Mira: repro: `python -c "from tokenizers import Tokenizer; t=Tokenizer.from_file('sapphire-vocab.json'); print(t.encode('—').ids)"` => returns [5023] but converter expects 45. Also saw duplicate BOS when input contains U+2014.
Cheng: likely normalization difference (NFKC vs none) during conversion. Also exported rotary angles seem ~1.0014x upstream — could be exporter transpose/scale quirk.
Mira: quant-smoke: `./run_quant_smoke.sh sapphire int4` -> exit 0 but LAMBADA +12% perplexity and some token mismatches.
Devon: run `./scripts/tokenmap-check --model sapphire --vocab` and attach CSV.
ops-bot: tokenmap-check done: 2 collisions (U+2014 vs hyphen combos). suggested remap: s3://redwood/onboard/sapphire/token_remap.json
Cheng: proposal: 1) apply NFKC in conversion pipeline before token map, 2) apply token_remap, 3) if needed, load-time rotary_scale=0.9986 and re-quantize; add per-channel int4 calibration.
Mira: I'll try nfkc + remap first (fast). if that clears token mismatches, should recover most QA drift.
Devon: also add a small kvcache replay unit test — duplication of BOS caused an off-by-one in replay.
ci-bot: nightly-smoke triggered for sapphire: job/6789 (https://ci.redwood/jobs/6789).
Mira: result: nfkc+remap -> LAMBADA delta down to +3%, samples align. next: rotary tweak run on full quant bench.
Devon: if rotary tweak helps, do 24h canary on dedicated with throttled traffic, then update model-catalog metadata (rotary_scale=0.9986, tokenizer_remap=s3://redwood/onboard/sapphire/token_remap.json).
Mira: will update onboarding notes and link remap. thanks :thumbsup:
